text:
maria: heads up — after the async proxy rollout i’m seeing quota charts drop for a subset of clients. looks like requests are landing but not attributed in the console :eyes:
sam: same, noticed around 11:22 UTC. console shows token usage spike then a gap, while infra logs show steady traffic
alex: do we have a sample request/headers that failed attribution?
maria: yep — from svc-replayer, pasted below:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx
X-Client-ID: svc-replayer
X-Route: internal-proxy
X-Telemetry-Mode: async
X-Route-Metadata: {"pool":"dedicated-a"}
```
jin: ah that X-Telemetry-Mode header is the key — proxy now batches async telemetry and emits at a later timestamp. console query window is aligned to request arrival not telemetry emission so attribution misses the window
maria: that would explain the gap — runs fine in infra but the console's aggregation lambda expects immediate telemetry events
sam: is the fix to backfill timestamps in the telemetry event with request_time or to change console aggregation window?
alex: short term: we can patch the proxy to emit telemetry with request_ts field so console can correlate. longer term: console should join by request_id not just timestamp
jin: agree. minimal patch: set telemetry.payload.request_ts = now_request_ts and include request_id header. i can whip up a small PR to the proxy
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: proxy-async-telemetry v2.1 -> prod :rocket:
maria: thank you. can we also surface a dashboard flag when telemetry mode!=sync? would help support triage
sam: +1. also add a note in release notes and a short blurb in console docs about async telemetry caveats
alex: i'll open a console ticket to extend aggregation window and to prefer request_id join. assign to @jin to do proxy patch first
jin: will do PR today. test plan: replay svc-replayer traces, validate console attribution and quota math for 1h windows
maria: leaving this thread here for context — support is getting pings. tagging @eng-platform for visibility :thumbsup:
